content: Jesus khuadak a, sumkholna sungah mihaute i sumpi khiak mu hi.
Taciang a zawng meingong nu khat i dangka san pia ni a khiak zong mu hi.

content.text: A tatak kong ci ciang, hi a zawng meingong nu in ngualdang theampo sang in a tamzaw khia hi:
Banghangziam cile midang te in a dimlet a nei uh sung pan in Pathian atu a piak uh teng khia hi: ahihang hi meingong nu a hile zawng napi, a nuntak natu in a nei theampo khia hi,

content: Mi pawlkhat te in biakinn sia suangtum hoi mama te le a kipia van te taw a kizep nathu a son uh ciang in,

content.text: Hi na mu uh nate, kuama in vawk ngawl napi, suangtum khat le khat a ki thuap nawn ngawl hun hong theng tu hi,

content: Amate in Jesus kungah, Syapa awng, hibang te banghun ciang piang tu ziam? hibang te hong pian tu ciang in bangbang musakna om tu ziam? ci in dong uh hi.

content.text: Ngual i theam na hi ngawl natu uh in kidawm vun: banghangziam cile mi tampi te keima min taw hongpai tu uh a, keima in Christ ka hihi; a hun hong nai zo hi, ci tu uh hi: hi kamale amate zui heak vun.
Ahihang ngal ki do na le tualngal thu te na zak uh ciang in lau heak vun: banghangziam cile hibang te hong piang masa hamtang tu hi; ahizong a tawpna hong theng pai ngawl lai tu hi,
Minam khat le namkhat, kumpi ngam khat le khat ki langpan tu hi:
Mun tatuam te ah a nasia mama zinling tu a, kial le pul te hong tung tu hi; vantung ah a kimu thei a lauhuai te le musakna tatuam te hong om tu hi.
Ahizong hite theampo a pian ma in, amate in hong man tu uh a, hong vawtsia in synagogue le thonginn ah hong ap tu uh hi, keima min hang in kumpi te le ngam uk te mai ah hong then tu uh hi.
Tasia sia note atu tettipanna hong suak tu hi.
Tua ahikom note i thin sungah, bangbang in zo tu, ci ngaisun khol heak vun:
Banghangziam cile na ngalte theampo i hong nial zawk ngawl tu le hong nal zawk ngawl tu in pau thiam nale ciimna kong pia tu hi.
Na nu le na pa, na suapui, na mealheak le na lawmte in hong zuak tu uh hi; pawlkhat te thi tu ciangdong in hong then tu uh hi.
Keima min hang in mi theampo in hong ensan tu uh hi.
Ahihang na lutung samzam khat zong sumsi ngawl tu hi.
Na thuakzawkna uh sungah nuntakna na nei tu uh hi.
Jerusalem sia ngalkap te in a kimum na mu uh ciang in, siatsuana hong nai zo hi, ci na tel tu uh hi.
Tua hun ciang in Judah ngam a omte mual tungah tai tahen; khuasung ah a omte khuapua ah pusuak tahen; duisung ah a omte khuasung ah tum heak tahen.
Banghangziam cile tua hun sia phu lak ni hi tu hi, ci a ki atkhol theampo tangtun natu a hihi.
Ahihang tua hun laitak in naupai te le nausen noailuai lai nei te mailam bing tu hi! banghangziam cile Judah ngam ah haksatna lianpi theng tu a, Judah minam te tungah Pathian thin-ukna theng tu hi.
Amate namsau taw puk tu uh a, ngam theampo ah sal in ki kai tu hi: Jerusalem sia Gentile te hun a bo dong Gentile te in sik tu uh hi.
Ni le tha le aksite tungah musakna te hong om tu a; leitung minam theampo tungah thinngimna le dipkuatna hong theng tu hi; tuipi le tuihual te hawk tu hi;
Leitung ah a theng tu te en in mihing te thin sia lau na hang in but thi in puk tu uh hi: banghangziam cile vantung vangletna te ki thiing tu hi.
Tuazawkciang in mihing Tapa sia mei tung pan in vangletna le minthanna lianpi taw hongpai amate in mu tu uh hi.
Hibang te hong thet kipat ciang in, dak in na lu tung vun; banghangziam cile note i ngupkhiatna ni hong nai zo hi,

content: Jesus in amate tungah sontena khat son hi;

content.text: Theikung le thingkung theampo en vun;
A te no meang hong sua ciang in khuakhal hun hong nai zo hi, ci mu in na he uh hi.
Tasia bangma in, hibang te hong thet na mu uh ciang in, Pathian kumpingam hong nai zo hi, ci he tavun.
A man tatak kong ci ciang, hi thu te theampo a tangtut mateng, hi minam bothong ngawl tu hi.
Van le lei bo tu hi: ahihang ka kammal te bo ngawl tu hi.

content: Kuama In A Hun He Ngawl Hi

content.text: Note ki nging in om vun, a valkai neak le dawn hu in thinngimna le zu kham buaina, leitung nuntakna atu thintoi in na om uh le, tua ni sia muanmawkngawl het laitak in note tungah hong theng tu hi.
Banghangziam cile leitung mi theampo tungah thaang bang in hong theng tu hi.
Tua ahikom note in ngak nginge vun, hong theng tu na theampo pan a suakta tu a kilawm tu le mihing Tapa mai ah ding tu in thungen tawntung vun,

content: Jesus sia sun hun sung in biakinn sungah thuhil hi; zan ciang in a puasang pusuak a, Olive mual tungah ngiak hi.
Mi theampo zingtung in a thuhilna ngai nuam in biakinn sung ama kungah hongpai uh hi.
